headline: Weathered Expanse Active as Nevish Line Goes Quiet
war_summary: The wires show a cooling since the early morning edition, with the Nevish Line recording no changes in the last two hours after 68 in the day about Blackcoat Way, Princefal and Grief Mother, holding seven Warden and one Colonial, and Marban Hollow likewise quiet in two hours with six in six and twelve in the day about Checkpoint Bua for one Warden, six Colonial and one neutral. Linn Mercy counts none in two hours with three in six and thirteen in the day about Lathair for ten Colonial and one neutral, while the Weathered Expanse remains the livest wire with three in two hours and fifty-two in the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk for six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral. New movement appears at Mooring County about The Wind Hills and at Godcrofts about Argosa, both logged near 0851, and Kuura Strand stays silent in the last six hours. Callahan's Passage spends 5,332 Colonial and 3,088 Warden casualties in the day without a recorded flip.
